elements.description: An agent-written email waiting for review: recipient, attachment, tones, inline editing, Discard and Send.

properties.name: reference
properties.description: Reference of the record, e.g. a subscription or invoice number

properties.name: account
properties.description: Account or company under the reference

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status chip next to the reference

properties.name: contacts
properties.default: [ { name: "Jonas Weber", email: "jonas@northwind.io" }, { name: "Lena Hart", email: "lena@northwind.io" }, { name: "Finance team", email: "billing@northwind.io" }, ]

properties.name: recipient
properties.description: The email of the contact it goes to – unset is the first contact; one not in `contacts` falls back to the first

properties.name: attachment
properties.description: The file attached – removing it is remembered for that file only, so a new attachment shows again

properties.name: tones
properties.default: [ { id: "friendly", label: "Friendly", body: (c) => `Hi ${first(c)}, a heads-up that your Growth plan renews on October 9 for $8,900 a year. If you'd like to add seats or switch to monthly billing, you can review the quote here:`, }, { id: "short", label: "Short", body: (c) => `Hi ${first(c)}, your Growth plan renews on October 9 ($8,900/year). Quote for changes:`, }, { id: "formal", label: "Formal", body: (c) => `Dear ${c.name}, this is a reminder that your Growth subscription is scheduled to renew on October 9 at $8,900 per year. Should you wish to adjust seats or billing, please review the attached quote:`, }, ]
properties.description: Text variants to switch between – the first one is shown first

properties.name: tone
properties.description: The id of the tone shown – unset is the first; one not in `tones` falls back to the first

properties.name: link
properties.description: Label and target of the link appended to the email

properties.name: onSend
properties.description:
Sends the email. Return a promise to keep the card in its sending state until it settles – a rejection brings
the draft back with an error. Without it sending is simulated (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

properties.name: undoSend
properties.description: The receipt offers Undo for a send (tc-undo takes it back) – unset: only when there's no `onSend`

properties.name: undoDiscard
properties.description: The receipt offers Undo for a discard (tc-undo takes it back) – unset: yes

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: sending without onSend is simulated silently. For galleries and prototypes

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-recipient-change
events.description: Another contact is picked; detail `{ email: string, contact: DraftContact }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `recipient`

events.name: tc-tone-change
events.description: Another tone is picked; detail `{ tone: string }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `tone`

events.name: tc-undo
events.description: A send or discard is taken back from the receipt; detail `{ action: "send" | "discard" }`

props.name: recipient
props.description: The email of the contact it goes to – controlled when defined; one not in `contacts` falls back to the first

props.name: defaultRecipient
props.description: The email of the contact picked at first – defaults to the first contact

props.name: tone
props.description: The id of the tone shown – controlled when defined; one not in `tones` falls back to the first

props.name: onUndo
props.description:
Takes back a send or a discard that already reached you through onSend / onDiscard. Without it the receipt
offers no Undo for those – only for what never left the component
